notable_fighters.name: Brian Kamau
notable_fighters.achievements: Multiple county and regional competitions. One of the most consistent competitors ORBC has produced. Has represented the club at national level.

notable_fighters.name: Kevin Otieno
notable_fighters.achievements: Competed at county, regional, and national level. Has faced opposition from clubs across Kenya and grown with every bout.

notable_fighters.name: Daniel Muriithi
notable_fighters.achievements: A product of the ORBC youth program. Has competed at multiple county-level events and continues to develop under Coach Michael.

notable_fighters.name: Alex Mwangi
notable_fighters.achievements: Began training at ORBC as a young teenager. Has competed in county opens and regional competitions, representing the club with discipline.

notable_fighters.name: Samuel Njoroge
notable_fighters.achievements: Part of ORBC's junior competition team. Has participated in intermediate league events and regional opens.

notable_fighters.name: James Odhiambo
notable_fighters.achievements: Came through the ORBC youth program and progressed to the competition team. Competed at junior level across Nairobi and Kajiado regions.
